blocks.html: The context passed to an index definition's `seed` function.

types.name: container
types.description: The resources available while turning an event into documents.

children.name: query
children.description: Query, used to retrieve the data the documents are built from.

children.name: graph
children.description:
Graph function uses the remoteQuery under the hood and
returns a result set

children.name: index
children.description:
Index function uses the index module to query and remoteQuery to hydrate the data
returns a result set

children.name: search
children.description: Search function uses the search module and hydrates the results through graph

children.name: gql
children.description: Query wrapper to provide specific GraphQL like API around remoteQuery.query

types.name: index
types.description: The definition of the index the documents are written to.

children.name: name
children.description:
The index's unique name, which is what `query.search({ entity })` resolves
against.

children.name: entity
children.description: The `query.graph` entrypoint used to hydrate non-indexed fields.

children.name: primary_key
children.description:
The field whose value keys the index's documents, which is what a hit's `id`
holds.

children.name: provider
children.description:
The identifier of the provider backing this index. Defaults to the module's
configured default provider.

children.name: fields
children.description: The fields the index holds, keyed by their path in the document.

children.name: type
children.description: The field's type.

children.name: array
children.description: Whether the field holds an array of the declared `type`.

children.name: searchable
children.description:
Whether the field is matched against a free-text query, optionally with a
`weight` boosting its relevance. The weight is applied at build time on some
engines, such as Meilisearch and Algolia, and at query time on others, such
as Typesense and Elasticsearch.

children.name: filterable
children.description: Whether the field can be used in a query's filters.

children.name: sortable
children.description: Whether results can be sorted by the field.

children.name: facetable
children.description:
Whether the field can be faceted, and which facet types it supports.
Defaults to `["value"]`, or `["range"]` for numeric and date fields.
`"stats"` is opt-in, since implying it would make numeric fields unusable on
providers without aggregations.

children.name: retrievable
children.description:
Whether the field comes back on hits. `false` for index-only fields, such as a
blob used purely for matching. `query.search` reads this to decide which
requested fields the engine can serve and which need `query.graph`.

Vector fields default to not retrievable — embeddings are not useful on
hits. Set `retrievable: true`, or `.retrievable()` in the DSL, to return
them.

children.name: fields
children.description: The fields of a nested object, only used when `type` is `object`.

children.name: dimensions
children.description:
The dimensionality of the embedding stored in a `type: "vector"` field.
Required for vector fields; meaningless on any other type. When `embed` is
omitted, every vector written to the field must have exactly this many
components.

children.name: embed
children.description:
When `true` on a vector field, documents pass a string and the engine
embeds it at write time, and for `search_options.vector.query` at query
time. Omit `embed` to supply embeddings yourself as a `number[]`.

children.name: provider_options
children.description:
Field options specific to a search engine, keyed by provider identifier, such
as `{ meilisearch: { ... } }`.

children.name: settings
children.description: The settings applied to the index when it's created or migrated.

children.name: synonyms
children.description: Terms treated as equivalent when matching, keyed by the term they expand to.

children.name: stop_words
children.description: Terms ignored when matching, such as `the` or `a`.

children.name: typo_tolerance
children.description: How misspelled terms are matched.

children.name: faceting
children.description: The defaults applied to the facets computed on this index.

children.name: pagination
children.description: The limits applied when paginating this index.

children.name: distinct_attribute
children.description:
The dotted path of a field that hits are deduplicated by, returning at most
one hit per distinct value.

children.name: locales
children.description: The languages the index's text is analyzed for, such as `["en"]`.

children.name: provider_options
children.description: Index settings specific to a search engine, keyed by provider identifier.

children.name: events
children.description: Events related and that can affect the data for this index.

children.name: consume
children.description: Executed on event ingestion to determine the action that needs to be performed on the index.

children.name: seed
children.description:
Yields the index's documents in batches. Ran when there is no data in the
index or on reindex.

types.name: filters
types.description:
Restricts a partial reindex to a subset of the entity, as passed to the
Search Module's `reindex` method.

types.name: last_key
types.description: The `last_key` of an interrupted run, when resuming one.
